model.summary: Model favors NE by 4.1 points (65% win chance). Biggest factors: Elo rating (NE +0.8), Rest days (home minus away) (GB +0.7), Scoring margin (season blend) (NE +0.5). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 45.5 total points (NE 25, GB 21). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 2.4), Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (lowers total 1.2), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 1.1). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.

qb_what_if.note: Approximate: swaps only the quarterback rating and the model's QB-change flag (a new starter counts as a change). Team offense and defense form stay as they are. A positive margin change favors the home team.
